service.description: New registration or renewal of the RD Service of a fingerprint / iris device (Mantra, Morpho, Startek and others), with the driver set up on the PC or mobile.
service.depending: The biometric device, its model and serial number, the PC or mobile it works with, the old RD Service validity (for a renewal)
service.rules: RD Service has a validity (usually 1–2 years) — enter the new validity as the renewal date in the job. Test with an Aadhaar authentication before handing over.
